'''Jarrti'Klomas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Klomas was captured by [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]], but was rescued by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vhiin Thorla]] and went to live in [[The Enclave]], a community of outcasts that Thorla had established on Ryloth. Klomas became the unofficial head of The Enclave's security force.

==Personality and traits==
Klomas disliked slavers and believed that Thorla was too good-natured, and should be more aggressive in dealing with slavers. He believed that if more people were freed from the slavers, then they could fight the slavers and rid Ryloth of them.
